The paper also includes ablation studies that highlight the importance of language instructions and the semi-synthetic training approach for LICO's performance. The authors further investigate the impact of different LLM sizes on performance, showing that larger models generally lead to better optimization results. Overall, the paper presents a compelling approach for applying LLMs to scientific optimization tasks, demonstrating the potential of LLMs to go beyond natural language processing and contribute to areas like molecular design.
